PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Senior Manager – Vendor Payments & Process Engineering   |   ICICI Bank 
Hyderabad, India   •   February 2021 – Present 
▪ Championed business process re-engineering (BPR) initiatives across the corporate banking vendor 
payments ecosystem, applying Six Sigma Black Belt methodologies (DMAIC, Value Stream Mapping, Root 
Cause Analysis) to eliminate waste and drive end-to-end workflow optimisation across a team of 25+ 
professionals. 
▪ Led mobilisation of process engineering improvement programmes across multiple operational units — 
including defining scope, preparing project charters, scheduling training sessions, and coordinating 
communications with stakeholders at all levels, mirroring Black Belt / Green Belt programme management 
practices. 
▪ Designed and delivered structured process engineering training and capability-building sessions for 
operations staff and business analysts on Six Sigma Black Belt tools including SIPOC, Fishbone diagrams, 
control charts, and statistical process control — fostering a continuous improvement culture across corporate 
banking functions. 
▪ Drove 5+ LSS-aligned productivity and efficiency improvement projects from ideation to closure — including 
a scan-based invoice processing automation, vendor payment analysis re-engineering, and asset register 
bulk upload automation — generating ₹111.93 Cr in savings and reducing payment TAT from 7 days to 2 
days. 
▪ Championed Process Discovery and Data Discovery initiatives using Six Sigma statistical tools to analyse 
high-volume corporate banking transaction data, identify process bottlenecks, and build data -backed 
business cases for automation and AI-led innovation in payment operations. 
▪ Explored and implemented innovative working methods through automation — including an end-to-end 
purchase-order-based payment automation that eliminated 80% of manual intervention and reduced 
processing errors by 80% — aligning with organisation-wide digital transformation and AI adoption goals. 
▪ Developed and maintained process engineering-related materials including SOPs, re-engineering playbooks, 
training decks, newsletters, and executive reporting dashboards — supporting communication 
standardisation and knowledge management across the corporate banking division. 
▪ Assisted in establishing standards for internal communications and performance reporting, enabling 
consistent tracking of process improvement outcomes and productivity metrics for senior leadership.  
▪ Organised and facilitated cross-functional process community engagement events, promoting process 
excellence culture and knowledge-sharing across operations, IT, procurement, and compliance stakeholders.  
▪ Conducted vendor audits ensuring full adherence to RBI guidelines, SOX compliance standards, and internal 
audit controls; managed UAT coordination and transition management for banking transformation initiatives.  
▪ Identified IT scrap revenue opportunities through structured process analysis, resulting in incremental annual 
gains of ₹2 Cr; implemented fraud-detection controls generating ₹2.5 Cr in annual savings through Six 
Sigma-driven duplicate payment identification. 
Manager – Branch Banking & Process Improvement   |   ICICI Bank 
Udaipur, India   •   November 2017 – January 2021 
▪ Applied Lean process engineering principles and business process re-engineering frameworks to optimise 
branch banking operations, streamline customer onboarding workflows, and improve sales -process 
efficiency across multi-function teams in a corporate banking environment. 
▪ Mentored branch staff and junior managers on continuous improvement methodologies and Six Sigma 
Green Belt tools including process mapping, 5S, and Kaizen — driving consistent application of process 
excellence practices across daily operations. 
▪ Built and delivered high-impact presentations to regional leadership and key stakeholders on branch 
performance metrics, process improvement outcomes, and strategic initiatives — demonstrating strong 
presentation-building and delivery capabilities. 
▪ Led structured work-plan development for customer-facing improvement programmes, managing full 
stakeholder engagement cycles and influencing cross-functional buy-in for process change initiatives. 
▪ Monitored KPIs and prepared detailed management reports on operational performance, identifying patterns 
and process inefficiencies using data-driven analysis aligned with Six Sigma Black Belt statistical thinking.  
▪ Collaborated with marketing and product teams to assess and improve customer engagement processes, 
contributing to campaign optimisation and sales process re-engineering in the corporate banking segment. 
Deputy Manager – AML & Compliance Operations   |   ICICI Bank 
Hyderabad, India   •   May 2014 – October 2017 
▪ Applied business process re-engineering and Six Sigma Black Belt analytical tools to restructure AML 
transaction monitoring workflows, reducing investigation cycle time and improving Suspicious Transaction 
Report (STR) accuracy. 
▪ Conducted process discovery exercises to map end-to-end AML compliance workflows across corporate 
banking client segments, identifying control gaps and implementing process controls aligned with RBI and 
FATF regulatory requirements. 
▪ Delivered training sessions for AML operations team members on updated process standards, compliance 
frameworks, and data-discovery methodologies — building team capability in Six Sigma-aligned process 
thinking. 
▪ Prepared detailed STRs and Grounds of Suspicion reports; maintained all compliance records and submitted 
periodic reports to the Head Office — demonstrating strong documentation, communication, and reporting 
standards. 
KEY PROCESS ENGINEERING PROJECTS & INITIATIVES 
▪ BPR Project: Vendor Payment Analysis Process Automation 
▪ Applied DMAIC methodology to re-engineer vendor payment analysis workflows; eliminated manual 
touchpoints, implemented automated control checks, and built real-time reporting dashboards. Reduced 
error rates by 80% and delivered measurable compliance improvement across corporate banking vendor 
operations. 
▪ BPR Project: GST Implementation & UAT Management 
▪ Led end-to-end process re-engineering for GST transition — redesigned tax-computation workflows using 
Six Sigma process mapping tools, managed UAT, trained 25+ stakeholders, and ensured zero -disruption 
cutover for corporate banking payment operations. 
▪ Process Engineering: Invoice Processing Automation (Scan-Based) 
▪ Deployed Six Sigma Value Stream Mapping to identify waste in manual invoice handling; implemented scan -
based automation reducing manual dependency and accelerating processing TAT — a model replicable 
across regional corporate banking operations. 
▪ Process Innovation: Go Green Utility Payment Automation 
▪ Championed a paperless digital transformation initiative using Lean principles, eliminating manual utility 
payment processing and contributing to the bank's automation and AI innovation agenda.
